newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Nearby January wheat in Sydney dips 50c/tonne.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Nearby January wheat in Sydney dips 50c/tonne.

text.p: Nearby January wheat futures settled 50 cents lower at A$162.50 a tonne on volume of seven 50-tonne lots on Friday.
Trading in Sydney wheat futures was limited to the Sydney Futures Exchange's overnight screen dealing system, SYCOM, on Friday due to the Christmas holiday season break.
Floor trading of wheat is scheduled to resume at the SFE on January 2, 1997.
The trades were made betwwen two local commodities trading houses, grains traders said.
